$description: Colours and type the website takes from Daniel's logo (brand/logo/daniel-refined/web). Extracted 2026-09-15. Every value aliases brand/design-tokens.json; the logo introduces no colour outside the palette, so the site keeps one source of truth. Use these roles where the site echoes the logo (header, footer, hero); use the ordinary semantic roles everywhere else.

ring.$description: The ring and the main peak. Also the site's heading and nav colour.

peak-far.$description: The secondary peak. Also secondary text.

snow.$description: The snow cap. Also cards and raised surfaces.

cactus.$description: The saguaro (mid sage, 3:1 on the page). The one colour the logo adds to a page: use it for icons and a single accent (the active nav marker), never for text and never as a button fill; positive state text is the semantic positive role.

wordmark.$description: Desert Peak / INSURANCE in the web lockup.

wordmark-accent.$description: INSURANCE in the stacked print version (v1). On the site the action colour is the badge's navy: buttons, links.

ground.$description: The paper the logo sits on. The page background.

ground-inverse.$description: Where the reversed lockup goes: footer, dark panels.

wordmark.$description: Archivo, the wordmark's face. Headings and UI.

body.$description: Source Serif 4 for long-form; the print card's serif is the same family.

wordmark-width.$description: The wordmark is set at Archivo width 112; use the same for display headings so the site and the logo share one voice.

header-desktop.$description: logo-horizontal.svg height in the site header (bar 80 px).

favicon-note.$value: The badge does not survive 16 px; use ../v2/logo-mark-small.svg or brand/logos/favicon.svg.
